verdict.summary: The change correctly widens transient HTTP read retries from a three-code allow-list to the complete 500–599 server-error range while preserving the existing GET/HEAD-only replay guard, bounded attempt count, Retry-After handling, loud exhaustion behavior, CAS-conflict precedence, and immediate failure for all 4xx responses and mutations. The added self-tests are non-vacuous: they pin both classifier boundaries and the production request call site, including recovery from a one-shot 500, bounded failure for a persistent 500, and no replay of a POST. No trust check, audit binding, permission boundary, or credential handling is weakened.
